d:
Shravni mela 2026 ki pavan kanvar yatra men aapka svagat hai.
Bihar sarkar dvara kanvriyon ki suvidha hetu chikitsa, peyjal, vishram sthal, svachchhata, suraksha, tent siti,jivika didi ki rasoee dvara shuddh satvik bhojan tatha any aavashyak suvidhaen pure kanvar path par sunishchit ki gaee hain.
Yatra ko aur adhik sugam banane ke lie bihar paryatan mobail aip daunlod karen aur paryatan sthalon, aavashyak jankari tatha yatra sanbandhi suvidhaon ka labh uthaen.
Har har mahadev !
